top_signals.title: Hotel Wi-Fi attacks use custom malware to breach Microsoft 365 accounts
top_signals.summary: Microsoft has linked a global campaign targeting hospitality Wi-Fi networks to the Russian threat actor Midnight Blizzard, also known as APT29. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Crypto PAC Fairshake scores primary wins in Michigan and Washington
top_signals.summary: Fairshake backed Michigan's Bill Huizenga and Washington's Suzan DelBene, Kim Schrier, Marilyn Strickland and Amanda McKinney.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
